prompt: A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility in 2058: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, concrete pillars, coils of cable, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge. Empty of people, urgent, cold. Documentary still photograph, shot on a 35mm cinema camera in available light, natural film grain, unposed and observational, photorealistic, near-future hard science fiction, worn and lived-in. No captions, no subtitles, no watermark, no legible text anywhere. Muted cold palette with a few warm practical lamps.
